name: Ironclad Cove
summary: Deep beneath Westfall, the Defias Brotherhood hides a shipyard in Ironclad Cove. There, they build a war juggernaught with a passage to the sea.

sections.title: The Hidden Shipyard
sections.body:
At the deepest point of the Deadmines, Ironclad Cove opens into a vast sea cavern, now a fortified dockyard. Edwin VanCleef and the Defias Brotherhood are building an enormous warship here, the juggernaught. Wooden scaffolding, islets, and loading catwalks fill the cavern. Defias pirates, deckhands, and overseers watch over the work.

VanCleef means to do more than raid Westfall's farmsteads. He plans to assemble a private naval force that can bombard Stormwind's shores.

sections.title: Gateway to the Ocean
sections.body: Colossal iron-reinforced sea doors fill the cavern wall. Beyond them lies the Great Sea, along the coast of northern Stranglethorn Vale. Stormwind's naval fleet cannot see the cove. So the Brotherhood can move contraband, stage maritime raids, and prepare its naval assault along an unmonitored route.

faq.q: What is the ship in Ironclad Cove being built for?
aliases: why is there a ship here
faq.answer: The juggernaught is the centerpiece of Edwin VanCleef's military ambitions. The Defias Brotherhood built the massive warship deep beneath the earth, so it can pass unseen through subterranean water channels and strike Stormwind from the sea.

faq.q: Where does the large metal door in the cove lead?
aliases: where do the sea gates open
faq.answer: The massive gates open directly into the ocean along the coast of northern Stranglethorn Vale. Once open, they let the juggernaught sail into the Great Sea.
The Defias Brotherhood controls Ironclad Cove under Edwin VanCleef's command. Its hidden docks keep the juggernaught's construction secret.

faq.q: Who is the murloc aboard the ship?
aliases: why is there a murloc pirate
faq.answer: The murloc is Cookie, the Defias ship's cook. Armed with a rolling pin and cooking cauldrons, he has claimed the galley among the human and goblin renegades.

angles.text: For the Alliance, a full-sized war galleon buried beneath Westfall makes the Defias a military threat to the Kingdom of Stormwind, far beyond a regional bandit gang.
As a rogue, you see the height of Edwin VanCleef's craftsmanship, engineering skill, and underground logistics in Ironclad Cove. Thieves and outlaws consider it legendary.
